Introducing our standard artificial Ficus tree, crafted to bring the timeless beauty of nature into any space. Available in five size options ranging from 90cm to 210cm, this lifelike creation offers versatility to suit various environments.

Crafted with a natural timber trunk, each Ficus tree is carefully foliated by hand, ensuring a realistic appearance that will effortlessly enhance any setting. The intricate detailing of the foliage captures the essence of the Ficus plant, providing a striking and natural aesthetic.

For added convenience, our standard artificial Ficus tree is sold in a stability base, ensuring secure placement in any location. Please note that this base is designed for stability purposes and is not intended for display.

To further personalize your experience, take advantage of our optional potting charge. With this service, your artificial Ficus tree will be expertly delivered into the chosen display planter from our range, seamlessly integrating into your chosen décor scheme.

For those seeking a unique touch, we also offer this exquisite tree with variegated foliage, adding a delightful contrast of colors to your space. Whether you opt for the standard design or the variegated option, our artificial Ficus tree promises to elevate your interior with its timeless elegance and lifelike charm.

title: Bespoke Artificial Tree
desc:
This artificial tree is made to order with the foliage of your choice. Our team hand foliates the trees to order. The main trunk of these trees is resin and the branches are real timber. The trees are sold in the base as shown 27cm X 27cm. These trees are suitable for internal use.

For any of these trees, we would recommend a base of 50cm or larger for stability. This Fibreglass Square planter is a great option for the bespoke trees. However, if this isn't the style you are looking for please do browse our range of planters and be sure to include our potting charge as this will mean the tree is delivered fixed into the planter ready to display!

These bespoke artificial trees are delivered on a pallet. There is a simple build when the trees are delivered as the branches are removable on the tree and are taken off for transport. A drill is required to secure to branches back into pre-drilled labeled holes.

The trees lead time is around 3 weeks from order. Should you require your order urgently please do get in touch and we will always try our best to assist you!

With this artificial tree selection please choose the size of the tree and the foliage you would like to be used.
